remarks: Move right in and enjoy easy living in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath end-unit townhouse, perfectly situated in the desirable Norwalk community. Step inside to discover an inviting layout featuring gleaming wood floors throughout the main level and a modern kitchen equipped with high-end stainless-steel appliances-including a brand-new, never-used dishwasher-and abundant cabinet storage plus a huge walk-in pantry. Upstairs, both bedrooms offer large closets, ceiling fans for year-round comfort, and plush carpeting for a cozy feel. The spacious primary bedroom opens directly onto a private patio-perfect for morning coffee or unwinding after a long day. Both bathrooms have been refreshed with stylish new light fixtures and faucets, adding a touch of luxury throughout. Additional highlights include a brand-new living room ceiling fan with light, second-floor washer and dryer with extra storage, central air and heat newly installed in 2023, and a newer roof with a lifetime warranty (covered by the association). Enjoy the perks of low HOA fees that haven't increased in five years, ample parking for you and your guests, and community amenities like a sparkling pool with a new liner and an on-site playground. All within walking distance to local restaurants, schools, and everyday conveniences! This move-in-ready end unit checks all the boxes for comfortable, low-maintenance living in Norwalk-don't miss it!
